mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as the change in INDPRO is continuously observed.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO rises by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a robust economy with strong manufacturing and housing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.1% and HOUST rises > 0.1% in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST rise by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% compresses equity valuations due to higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active as the change in CPIAUCSL is continuously observed.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a strong housing market and robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.1% and RSAFS rises > 0.1% in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by at least 0.1% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are negative due to economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE is above 6.0%.
